title: 长方形面积
summary: 根据长和宽的数据计算长方形面积
scene_svg:
<g>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="inkWash" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fdfbf7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#fee2e2"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="vermilion" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a1c1c"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b94a48"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="5" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#1f2937" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="inkGlow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <style>
      .ink-text { font-family: "Noto Serif SC", "Songti SC", serif; fill: #1f2937; }
      .muted-text { font-family: "Noto Serif SC", "Songti SC", serif; fill: #78716c; }
      .accent-text { font-family: "Noto Serif SC", "Songti SC", serif; fill: #8a1c1c; font-weight: 700; }
      .dashed-line { fill: none; stroke: #78716c; stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 9 8; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .number-card { fill: #fdfbf7; stroke: #44403c; stroke-width: 2; }
      .float-soft { animation: floatSoft 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
      .heartbeat { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: heartbeat 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
      .ink-shimmer { animation: inkShimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
      @keyframes floatSoft { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-8px); } }
      @keyframes heartbeat { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.08); } }
      @keyframes inkShimmer { 0%,100% { opacity: .55; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 1" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-700" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 -translate-y-4" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0" class="float-soft">
    <text x="400" y="76" text-anchor="middle" class="ink-text" font-size="30">今天研究：面积怎么算？</text>
    <path d="M250 94 C330 102 470 102 550 94" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
    <text x="400" y="142" text-anchor="middle" class="muted-text" font-size="21">面积，就是平面里“占了多大地方”</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 2" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-800" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-75" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100" filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <rect x="135" y="205" width="180" height="116" rx="10" fill="url(#inkWash)" stroke="#44403c" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="225" y="252" text-anchor="middle" class="accent-text" font-size="38">长</text>
    <text x="225" y="291" text-anchor="middle" class="ink-text" font-size="26">10 厘米</text>
    <rect x="485" y="205" width="180" height="116" rx="10" fill="url(#inkWash)" stroke="#44403c" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="575" y="252" text-anchor="middle" class="accent-text" font-size="38">宽</text>
    <text x="575" y="291" text-anchor="middle" class="ink-text" font-size="26">6 厘米</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 3" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-800" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-x-8" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-x-0">
    <path d="M316 263 C365 263 430 263 484 263" class="dashed-line"/>
    <text x="400" y="244" text-anchor="middle" class="muted-text" font-size="20">两个已知条件</text>
    <circle cx="400" cy="263" r="8" fill="#8a1c1c" class="heartbeat"/>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 4" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-800" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-6" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <text x="400" y="383" text-anchor="middle" class="ink-text" font-size="28">长方形面积公式</text>
    <rect x="188" y="408" width="424" height="74" rx="12" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="400" y="456" text-anchor="middle" class="accent-text" font-size="30">面积 = 长 × 宽</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 5" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-800" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <path d="M225 322 C225 350 225 365 225 398" class="dashed-line"/>
    <path d="M575 322 C575 350 575 365 575 398" class="dashed-line"/>
    <text x="400" y="520" text-anchor="middle" class="muted-text" font-size="22">把题目中的长和宽代入公式</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 6" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-8" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0" class="ink-shimmer">
    <rect x="230" y="545" width="110" height="42" rx="8" class="number-card"/>
    <text x="285" y="574" text-anchor="middle" class="accent-text" font-size="25">10</text>
    <text x="372" y="574" text-anchor="middle" class="ink-text" font-size="29">×</text>
    <rect x="460" y="545" width="110" height="42" rx="8" class="number-card"/>
    <text x="515" y="574" text-anchor="middle" class="accent-text" font-size="25">6</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 7" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-75" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100" filter="url(#inkGlow)">
    <text x="400" y="574" text-anchor="middle" class="accent-text" font-size="32">10 × 6 = 60</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep === 8" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-1000" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-75" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100" class="heartbeat">
    <rect x="242" y="174" width="316" height="70" rx="14" fill="url(#vermilion)" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="400" y="219" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fdfbf7" font-size="31" font-family="Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, serif">答案：60 平方厘米</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 8" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-700" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <text x="400" y="112" text-anchor="middle" class="muted-text" font-size="20">验证：面积单位应是“平方厘米”</text>
  </g>
  </g>
